name: udp-blackhole
description: Every UDP datagram the client sends is silently dropped (no ICMP). QUIC-shaped families cannot complete a handshake; TCP families are untouched — and must still carry an app's UDP, because that travels inside the TCP tunnel.
analogue: Iran's standing posture toward outbound UDP ('UDP dropping that notably impacts QUIC'; the 2025 policy paper asks for 'complete and permanent blocking of outbound IPv6, UDP and ICMP'), and the HTTP/3 collapse on AS58224 before the January 2026 blackout. Model: all UDP, all ports, both directions. The real thing usually spares UDP/53 to the national resolver; see protocol-whitelist for that.
